instruction: A candid action photograph captures two martial artists in profile inside a karate dojo with yellow walls, sword racks, and red-and-blue floor mats. On the left, the woman in a black karate uniform with a red belt (R2) stands in a low sparring stance, facing right with her hands raised defensively. On the right, the older man in a black karate uniform with white stripes (R1) stands facing her, also in a sparring stance with his hands up. They maintain a distance of a few feet, preparing to engage. The bright overhead lighting evenly illuminates the entire training space.
elements: R2 is the martial artist in a low defensive sparring stance facing R1
R1 stands opposite R2 in a sparring stance with his hands raised
R1 and R2 keep a few feet of distance while preparing to engage
red-and-blue floor mats are present in the training space
the scene is inside a karate dojo

questions.q: Is R2 the one in the low defensive sparring stance facing R1, rather than R1 being assigned that specific low defensive stance?
questions.element: R2 holds the low defensive sparring role toward R1

questions.element: R1 is the opposite sparring partner to R2's low defensive stance

questions.q: Do R1 and R2 maintain a few feet of separation instead of making physical contact during the sparring setup?
questions.element: R1 and R2 are separated sparring opponents, not contacting
